title: fix(spec): field and object form expression help states what the engine does
body:
Closes #24735

Clause-②: no

## What

The `expression` help text in the field designer (`packages/spec/src/data/field.form.ts`) said the expression "makes it read-only". The engine does not do that. The object designer's field grid (`packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`) showed the `expression` row for `formula` fields only, with the help text "CEL formula expression". Both rows now carry the same sentence, which matches the landed `FieldSchema.expression` describe:

> CEL expression the field's value is computed from. On a formula field: computed on read, no stored column. On any other field: computed by the engine from the row each write stores, and stored, so a client-sent value never stands.

Nothing changes in behaviour, and no gate is added.

## Engine behaviour the text was checked against (`origin/main` 46bb5e3e54)

- `planStoredExpressions` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`): every non-`formula` field that declares an `expression` is computed over the row the write stores and written onto the payload. A client-sent value is overwritten.
- `stripComputedWriteFields`: strips `formula` fields only. A `formula` has no column and is computed on read.
- `settleBulkStoredExpressions`: a predicate update that moves an input stores the single value when every matched row agrees, and refuses the update otherwise.
- Only `readonly: true` makes a client value a readonly drop.

The sentence makes no claim about whether the overwrite is reported. It stays true before and after the open draft for #24690, which would add a `stored_expression` dropped-field report. "A client-sent value never stands" holds either way.

## Grid row decision: widened to every type

`FieldSchema` accepts `expression` on every field type: there is no type gate in `field.zod.ts`, and `planStoredExpressions` acts on any non-formula type. The field designer's own row has no `visibleWhen`. With the formula-only row, a stored field's live `expression` could not be seen or edited in the grid, while the field form showed it. I found no concrete reason to keep the narrower row, so the `visibleWhen` is removed and the help text matches `field.form.ts`. A comment at the row records why.

## Translations

The zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES values of both leaves made the same false claim, or the formula-only one. Two examples: zh-CN "自动设为只读" and es-ES "lo hace de solo lectura". AGENTS.md says translated-locale values are hand-written. The extractor's merge mode keeps every existing translated value, and authored leaves carry no source hash, so regenerating could not correct them. I re-translated the six leaves by hand. The `en` bundle was regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=platform-objects`, which rewrote only `en.metadata-forms.generated.ts`. The en pin for `object.fields['fields.expression'].helpText` in `object-field-editor-panel-echo-decisions.test.ts` follows the new source, with its reason amended.

## Verification (head 28b565d99c)

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: exit 0. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 702 files / 21352 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: 79 files / 1195 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n`: "OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)". `check:i18n-stale-fill`: OK.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 88 derived families accounted for, 87 run at exit 0. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. It exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET because unrelated workspace packages have no `dist/`. CI builds the whole workspace and runs it.
- `pnpm lint` (repo-wide eslint) was not run locally and is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Nothing was driven in a browser. The objectui grid renders the row from this form metadata, and the only change it sees is that `visibleWhen` is gone.
